name: memolens
description: Use confirmed creator preferences to find, review, and shape private local photo and video moments into an unsaved, provenance-grounded Timeline 1.0 draft.

interface.shortDescription: Your private creator library, ready to shape a story.
interface.longDescription: MemoLens gives Codex a calm, local-first path from creator context to story: read only preferences the user confirmed, find private photos and current video moments, review the non-destructive Media Inbox, and arrange selections into an unsaved hard-cut Timeline 1.0 draft. Safe-default access is read-only SQLite, and no third-party model API key is required. Inbox and profile changes stay in the MemoLens app; the plugin cannot save, render, export, delete, or write to arbitrary paths.
defaultPrompt: Use my confirmed creator style to find moments for a one-minute story.
Show my unreviewed photo and video inbox, then suggest what to keep for this idea.
Turn these MemoLens moments into an unsaved hard-cut timeline draft for review.
